law_name: Law No. 055/2024 of 20/06/2024 on the Protection of Intellectual Property
orphan_works: Law 055/2024 introduces mechanisms for use of orphan works (owners cannot be located); article number not confirmed
digital_protection: Prohibits circumventing effective technical measures; copyright-management info protected
fair_use_exceptions: Statutory exceptions (private copying, quotation, library reproduction, judicial use, accessible-format copies)
registration_required: No (registration available with the Registrar General)
enforcement_body: Rwanda Development Board (Office of the Registrar General)
